scope: Bounded numeric pixel blocks with divergent control flow, one shared instruction implementation, register-bank address reuse and uniform target-prefix staging. Wire marker 43 and archive contents unchanged. Compatible pointwise graph/program fusion remains unfinished.
method: ESP32 rev3.1, 240 MHz, one core, Wi-Fi off, GPIO untouched. Cargo release opt-level 3, fat LTO, one codegen unit. Standalone prepared-evaluation profiling image; instruction counting disabled while timing. Each case evaluates 32 frames including first use. Two-second controls bracket 997/1999 us PC sampling. Excludes network, storage, DMA and physical output. No laptop timing comparison.

correctness.rounding: Small floating-point rounding changes are allowed, but this batch preserves all reference-frame checksums.
correctness.focused_coverage: Divergent branches and loops, unequal loop counts, early returns, query reuse, differing target bounds/counts, short-to-full blocks and mixed-to-common target transitions. Existing Select coverage caught an incorrect scalar-only classification; Select remains lane-dependent.

validation: cargo fmt and full pnpm check passed, including frontend checks, all workspace tests, exhaustive schema validation (566.88 seconds), 16 device-storage tests and all-target/all-feature Clippy with warnings denied. Runtime coverage includes 121 unit tests and 11 allocation tests. Complete controller release image builds and links. Sixteen implementation/linker files match the measured snapshot after stripping disabled diagnostic counting hooks. All timing rows and three artifact hashes were verified against the captures.
deadlines: Mixed misses 60 Hz on all 32 frames. Stanford and Chase/Pulse 16 layers fit all 32. Shimmer 1200 fits at p95 but misses once on first use. These are evaluation times, not physical output deadlines.

dispatches_per_frame_before_after.note: A numeric instruction performs arithmetic for multiple active lanes. Fewer dispatches, including division dispatches, do not imply the same reduction in arithmetic operations. Mixed float-parameter loads remain 5403 per frame. Chase target-prefix division dispatches remain 32 per frame.

hotspot_percent.note: Weighted self-symbol shares across both sampling periods. One native VM symbol contains effect and operator execution; PC-only profiling cannot separate callers. Inlined curve sampling is not independently attributable in this image.

investigation.lane_iteration: Initial numeric execution made mixed 199664 us and overflowed controller instruction memory. On Xtensa, trailing_zeros expanded into a long software bit-search sequence and accounted for 15-19 percent of sampled PCs. Cohort formation now records lane order once, arithmetic borrows one register bank, and straight-line dispatch checks only the next stage/join event. The final complete controller fits.
investigation.target_staging: After dispatch simplification, Chase/Pulse 16 layers still measured 20803 us. Numeric execution repeated target-invariant divisions per lane. Restoring target-prefix initialization and broadcasting it once brings the final case to 14542 us. This proof uses target count/bounds, not effect identities, and handles short blocks and mixed target domains.
investigation.stanford: The final Stanford case is 1398 us slower than the previous image. A diagnostic image toggled numeric admission before archive decoding, leaving the native interpreter identical: numeric on measured 14993 us, numeric off 15638 us. Numeric scheduling therefore improves Stanford within the expanded interpreter; it does not cause the entire regression. Remaining shared-path overhead includes lane-aware register addressing and instruction-loop/control state. The experiment does not isolate their individual cycle costs. No workload-specific scalar switch is retained.
investigation.small_cases: Freeze increases 426 us, starter 29 us and scheduled cases 10 us. These tradeoffs are recorded alongside representative improvements; no extra dispatch specialization was added solely to recover isolated scores.

controller.stack_note: Individual function reservations, not a maximum recursive stack bound. The block operator includes eight lane contexts.
controller.hot_helpers: Flow::resume and Flow::merge_waiting map to 0x4008d798 and 0x4008d834 in the controller ELF; the hot linker selector includes both.

raw_evidence: Ignored target/vm-opt-20261002/numeric-target holds production captures, disassembly inputs, host preparation/count logs and complete controller artifacts. numeric-probe holds the same-image admission experiment and its diagnostic source. numeric-blocks/counts holds final instruction counts. numeric-final-check.log records the full repository gate. No raw logs or profiling images are committed.
